elements.name: Rectangle 24
elements.text:
FUTURE STATE OVERVIEW
Where we can differentiate…
Engagement channel: Invest in digital capabilities to delivery a robust, seamless omnichannel experience, tailored to specific client needs 
Offerings & advice: Provide full-suite offerings leveraging the entire Bank’s expertise and scale with a focus on hybrid advice1 
Where we can better meet client expectations…
Value for money: Introduce tiered packages & pricing based on client’s relationship with BNS
Branding: Create simple, human-centered messaging across offers and content
Ecosystem: Enhance mobile platforms to offer seamless digital experiences with greater (not complete) back-end integration
